userStories.title: Pit death trigger
userStories.description: As a player, I want to die when falling below the level floor boundary so that gaps in terrain are meaningful hazards.
acceptanceCriteria: Falling off the bottom of the level (y > level height in pixels) triggers DeathWindup -> Dying -> Respawning
Player respawns at level start position after death

userStories.title: Spike death trigger
userStories.description: As a player, I want to die instantly when contacting spike cells so that spikes are lethal terrain hazards.
acceptanceCriteria: Walking or falling onto a Spikes collision cell triggers DeathWindup -> Dying -> Respawning
Spikes are instant kill regardless of HP
Player respawns at level start position after death

userStories.title: Flag collision and level completion
userStories.description: As a player, I want to touch the flag to complete the level so that traversal has a win condition.
acceptanceCriteria: Player overlap with flag position (1872, 768) using a 16x16 hit region triggers level completion
On flag touch: freeze input, display LEVEL COMPLETE text
After a brief pause, the next level loads via advance_level() (or placeholder if no data)
Player can complete Level 1 from spawn to flag on real terrain

userStories.title: Enemy-player contact damage
userStories.description: As a player, I want to take damage when touching enemies so that traversal is dangerous.
acceptanceCriteria: AABB overlap between player hitbox and active enemy hitbox (16x16 default) triggers apply_damage()
Walking into a Diamond or MiniHoppingSkull deals damage
Invulnerability frames prevent rapid re-hits
Losing all HP triggers death sequence
Enemies remain alive after contact (player cannot kill them yet)

userStories.title: Pacer enemy movement (MiniHoppingSkull)
userStories.description: As a player, I want MiniHoppingSkull enemies to walk back and forth on terrain so they are real moving threats.
acceptanceCriteria: MiniHoppingSkull walks horizontally, reversing direction on wall collision or platform edge
Uses probe_wall() and probe_floor() for terrain collision
Pacers fall and land on terrain like the player (gravity)
Movement speed approximated from oracle traces or reasonable default (1-2 px/frame)
Enemies don't walk through walls or float

userStories.title: Static enemy archetype (Diamond)
userStories.description: As a player, I want Diamond enemies to remain stationary at their spawn position, matching original behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: Diamond stays at its spawn position
Diamond still participates in enemy-player collision checks

userStories.title: Prize block interaction
userStories.description: As a player, I want to headbutt prize blocks from below so the world reacts to my actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Player headbutts a prize block from below -> block changes to hit/empty state
Block state change updates the live BlockGrid so collision reflects new state
No item spawning yet (stub only)

userStories.title: Smash block interaction
userStories.description: As a player, I want to destroy smash blocks by headbutting from below so I can clear paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Player headbutts a smash block from below -> block is destroyed (cell set to empty)
Collision grid updates immediately — player can pass through destroyed blocks
Visual feedback when block grid rendering is available

userStories.title: Air control
userStories.description: As a player, I want to steer horizontally while airborne so I can make precise jumps.
acceptanceCriteria: Horizontal acceleration applied from input while on_ground == false
Air acceleration is reduced compared to ground acceleration
Max air speed is respected
Turning in air works but with slower response than ground
Matches original feel (verify against oracle trace if possible)

userStories.title: Block grid rendering
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see the terrain rendered as coloured rectangles so the level is visible instead of invisible.
acceptanceCriteria: Each non-empty cell rendered as a coloured rectangle (solid=grey, spikes=red, slope=brown)
Only cells visible within the camera viewport are drawn (not all 200x28 cells)
Block types visually distinguishable (prize=yellow, smash=orange, ice=cyan, rubber=pink)
Camera scrolling works correctly with rendered terrain
Performance acceptable (only visible cells drawn per frame)
Destroyed/hit blocks render as empty space
